title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

translated_title: 又一个概念漂移基准？一个用于评估漂移检测器的原则性框架
translated_abstract: 概念漂移检测是数据流学习的基本组成部分，然而其经验评估仍然基于定义松散的协议、含糊不清的警报语义和不一致的度量指标。我们提出了一个基于漂移可观测性和警报语义显式形式化的原则性基准。我们的框架引入了有限检测窗口和重复警报机制，实现了检测准确性、及时性和稳定性之间的清晰分离，并采用可复现的观察器提供受控且可解释的性能信号。基于这一形式化，我们定义了标准化的评估指标和一个综合评分，以解决现有度量方法的局限性。我们通过对10个检测器在9种学习器配置和16个数据集上进行的大规模压力测试评估来验证该框架。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于漂移可观测性和警报语义显式形式化的原则性概念漂移检测基准框架，通过引入有限检测窗口、重复警报和标准化综合评分指标，实现了检测准确性、及时性与稳定性的清晰分离，并通过对10个检测器在9种学习器配置和16个数据集上的大规模压力测试验证了框架的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a principled benchmark framework for concept drift detection grounded in explicit formulations of drift observability and alarm semantics, introducing finite detection windows, repeated alarms, and normalized composite metrics to clearly separate detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, validated through large-scale stress-testing of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.
